scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two bearded men in ochre and olive mantles lean over a blank parchment at a wooden table. The older man points while the seated man holds a reed pen. An inkpot and rolled scrolls sit nearby; sunlight reveals an olive tree and distant hills through a stone doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The unnamed officials and their scribal table imaginatively illustrate the makers and writers of unjust decrees condemned in this verse. Their stern, self-assured manner suggests misuse of authority; the blank parchment avoids inventing a decree. The room, clothing and landscape are artistic conventions, not a narrated meeting or established historical likeness.
